The immediate automated response included trip breaker VCB-101A, opening of relief valve SV-402, and bypass valve FV-101 to dissipate momentum. The operating envelope for K-101 specifies maximum allowable discharge pressure (145.0 PSI) and normal operating temperature (85.0°C). The observed discharge pressure (148.2 PSI) and temperature (87.4°C) exceeded these limits, triggering the safety interlock. The cause appears to be a combination of overpressure and temperature exceeding the safe operating limits.

If discharge pressure exceeds 450.0 PSI (31.02 bar) or bearing temperature breaches 95.0 °C:
1. The automated safety interlock trips breaker VCB-101A, de-energizing the main 450 kW drive motor.
